name: Yulon Motor Company Ltd.
summary: Yulon Motor Company Ltd. manufactures and markets automobiles and related products in Taiwan, China, and internationally. It operates through Brand Department, Cooperation Department, Level System, Taiwan Passage System, China Access System, and Others segments. The company manufactures, imports, exports, sells, maintains, repairs, leases, and trades in automobiles and related materials; manages a basketball team; electric vehicles, automobile components, automotive interior, and car seats; and provides investment, general advertising planning, labor, product design, energy technology, towing and lifting, taxi passenger transport, property insurance, real estate leasing, management consultin…
